genius.notes: The exact EURW issuer is Newrails, UAB, company code 305270426. Its Lithuanian EMI/EMT authorization and MiCA whitepaper establish foreign regulatory context; they do not establish a U.S. GENIUS pathway. As of 2026-10-07, no public token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application or registered foreign-issuer exception was found in the reviewed sources. Direct par redemption and reserve-policy disclosures are public. The product page claims monthly attestation reports are published publicly, but no actual report or report archive was located in the reviewed product, whitepaper or redemption materials, so monthlyAttestationPresent is false. No U.S. GENIUS enforcement action was found; the Bank of Lithuania register separately records a historical 2023 domestic fine. Federal issuer rules remain proposed and expected Act effective date is January 18, 2027.
